# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on the `main` branch receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue**. Report it privately through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lmtejada/commerce-automation-practice/security/advisories/new).

Include a description, steps to reproduce, and the impact you expect. You can expect an
initial response within 7 days. Once a fix is released, the advisory will be published
with credit to you unless you prefer to stay anonymous.
